messages:
Noah Rivera: Pilot request from MarketSpark: they want mobile-first latency + safe quant recs. Can we scope an alpha?
Zara Khan: Let's propose a narrow alpha: runtime flag "mobile_fast_path", heuristic int8 recommendations with automatic fallback and per-customer telemetry, eval webhook for drift alerts.
Oliver Mehta: Runtime needs: adaptive batching (max_latency_ms=50), prefix KV cache enabled for short TTL (25s), SDK hint (mobile_fast_path=true). Also emit "quant_fallback" event with sample payload.
Priya Rao: Acceptance criteria suggestion: mobile p95 <130ms for 1-2 token hits, token cost reduction >=18%, nightly eval delta <=0.025 or fallback documented.
Infra-Bot: Capacity sim queued (params: rps=6/mobile-region, batch_window=50ms, model=rwd-6b-int8). ETA 10h.
Zara Khan: Timeline: 4 weeks for runtime + SDK flag + telemetry + heuristic endpoint. Full model recommender later.
Oliver Mehta: We'll ship heuristic rules: model-types eligible for int8, prompt families to exclude, and dynamic fallback thresholds.
Noah Rivera: Action owners: @Oliver runtime + SDK, @Infra run sims, @Priya eval harness, @Zara customer comms. Keep alpha tightly scoped.
Priya Rao: I'll draft pilot agreement and integration steps today.
Noah Rivera: Thanks, team. Keep me posted on sim results and any quality red flags. :shipit:
